skills.name: budget-review
skills.description: Build a defensible roofing budget for one property and one fiscal year from its roof sections, open deficiencies, past spend and existing budget items. Use when someone asks what to budget for a roof, a property or next year.
skills.description_zh: 依据单物业的屋顶分区、未修缺陷、历史支出及已有预算项，为一个财政年度编制可解释的屋顶预算。

skills.name: coverage-check
skills.description: Test an insurance policy held in the portal against the open deficiencies at one property, clause by clause, with the weather events that could have caused them. Use when someone asks whether damage or a deficiency might be covered.
skills.description_zh: 逐条比对门户中的保险合同与单物业未修缺陷，并关联可能导致损坏的天气事件，评估是否可能获保。

skills.name: invoice-review
skills.description: Judge whether an invoice matches the work the portal has a record of - the project, its progress reports, change orders, photos and any service agreement - and list what does not reconcile. Use when someone asks to check, review or explain an invoice.
skills.description_zh: 将屋顶工程发票与门户记录的项目、进度、变更单、照片和服务协议比较，列出无法对账的部分。

skills.name: owner-report
skills.description: Write an owner-facing report on a property or portfolio for a period - work done, money spent, open issues, weather, and what is coming. Use when someone asks for a quarterly, annual or board report on their roofs.
skills.description_zh: 按期间为物业或物业组合编写面向业主的屋顶报告，汇总已做工作、支出、未解决事项、天气及下一步，适用于季度年度或董事会报告。

skills.name: portfolio-briefing
skills.description: A one-page standing briefing on a whole roofing portfolio - open risk, work in flight, weather, expiring coverage and money owed. Use when someone asks for a status update, a summary of their properties, or what needs attention this month.
skills.description_zh: 生成整个屋顶物业组合的一页常规简报，涵盖未解决风险、在建工作、天气、将到期保障和欠款，指出本月需关注事项。

skills.name: roof-life-forecast
skills.description: Forecast the next several years of roof replacement and major repair across one property or a whole portfolio, ranked by urgency with a cost per year. Use when someone asks how long roofs will last, when to replace, or for a multi-year capital plan.
skills.description_zh: 预测单物业或组合未来数年的屋顶更换及重大修复，按紧急程度排序并给出逐年成本，用于多年度资本计划。

skills.name: storm-impact
skills.description: Assess which properties a storm on a given date could have damaged, and what has been found or done at them since. Use when someone asks about hail, wind or a storm date and their roofs.
skills.description_zh: 评估指定日期暴风雨、冰雹或强风可能损坏哪些物业，并汇总事后发现和采取的措施。

skills.name: warranty-check
skills.description: Decide whether any warranty on a property may cover a specific deficiency or leak, from the warranty records and the warranty documents' own text. Use when someone asks if something is under warranty or what a warranty excludes.
skills.description_zh: 依据物业保修记录及合同原文，判断具体缺陷或漏水是否可能受保，并解释排除项。
